summary: Universal CLI routing, diacritics-safe intents and GitHub project discovery

delivery.outcome: taskand "<zadanie>" routes without naming an organism, intents match with or without Polish diacritics, GitHub repositories are listed by a bounded builtin package, and structured results reach --format json|yaml|csv without pipe truncation.
nonGoals: Twin topology filter for ephemeral container interfaces (separate dependent slice)
Monag panel routes, capsule packaging standard, Planfile sync workflow and Gitea infrastructure left in the primary checkout
Redeploying the running gateway stage or mounting host repositories into the container
Changing the write-then-exit pattern in processes outside the chat path

architecture.decision: Keep routing in dev/chat intents and dev/act deterministic selection; add GitHub discovery as an immutable builtin package resolved through the registry; pass structured results through existing chat responses instead of a new endpoint.
interfaceChanges: CLI: taskand "<zadanie>" universal routing and --format json|yaml|csv|txt|table
POST /api/chat forwards structured result fields (result, devices, projects, summary)
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; registry entries return to the previous bindingHash and github-projects-discovery/v2 disappears with its genome line.

validation.evidence: Intent diacritics, capture and word-boundary cases
Discovery fixtures: origins, linked worktree, depth, credentials, invalid input
700-repository CLI query through dev/chat and dev/act in json and csv
Full local suites and managed governance gate
